scope: Official ACP, one native user Home, shared Gateway, call-time Session-to-Run CLI attribution; macOS arm64 Preview

controlled.provider: loopback scripted Responses; no paid model
isolation: one disposable user Home for both members
independent Core data and Runtime Files Root
Gateway launched before Core; its PATH does not include the later installed ~/.local/bin

interpretation: Two distinct members execute plain rovai send with no ROVAI_CLI_CONTEXT; Core determines their exact current Run.
A0 background invocation first made during A1 belongs to A1 by the approved call-time policy.
No-active and unknown Sessions are rejected without creating a message.
One cancelled Run does not stop the other Session or shared Gateway.
Core SIGKILL preserves the native Gateway; the original accepted task is not replayed, and the subsequent task resumes the original Session.
Gateway restart is performed by the fixture only; normal ACP resume restores assigned MCP credentials.
Actual model requests contain initial/updated rules only when required. Two committed native summaries create no Hermes redelivery requirement.
Native config and .env hashes remain unchanged; native system prompt is visible in model requests.
limits: Only local terminal front/background execution and one official native version on macOS arm64 were exercised.
execute_code, subagents, remote/container terminal backends, other platforms and paid model quality were not qualified.
No general cancellation rollback or immediate MCP revocation guarantee; native resume with empty MCP is not confirmation of removal.
Shared native long-term memory is not isolated by member; compressed rules have no permanent-preservation guarantee.
The daily user installation, App and Hermes data were not changed.

diagnosticAttempts.result: Retired compaction_recovery envelope still used for input budget reservation; both production reservation sites corrected.
MCP execution succeeded; fixture attempted to search a non-model request without input. Fixture now distinguishes these requests.
Cancellation succeeded; fixture selected the previous cancelled Run before the successor was scheduled. Query now starts after the submission boundary.
No-active request was rejected, but CLI flattened the IPC error. Native Session failures now use the existing safe business rejection envelope.

regression.overlap: Filtered owners overlap with workspace; counts are not additive.

priorParallelWorkspaceFailures.reason: Existing 2-second version probe timed out before identity-mismatch assertion. Focused rerun passed in 0.14 s and the complete serial workspace passed; Cursor implementation, budget and assertion unchanged.
